row.proto: void *Ui_Format_UInt64_WithUnitSuffix(void *fmt_cfg, void *out_str, uint64_t value, char flag_a, char flag_b, uint8_t unit_kind, uint32_t *compact_cfg)
row.notes: Number-to-text formatter: plain path uses "%0*I64u" with width cfg+0x10, optional thousands grouping (cfg+8, value>=1000) and cfg+0xc padding chars; compact path (compact_cfg[2] byte set) scales by a power of 10 chosen from compact_cfg bytes +4/+5 and builds "%s%s%.*s" with the decimal separator global 0x146ca3bb8, trimming trailing zeros. Then wraps with a unit template from table 0x145a871c0 (unit_kind 1..31, mask 0xffbfffbe) via Ui_Format_NumberText_Compact, or special case kind 6. Sign/prefix string chosen from flags.
